name: OpenHermes-2.5-Mistral-7B
notes: Architecture is Mistral-7B-v0.2's (MistralForCausalLM, hidden 4096, 32 layers, 32 query heads / 8 KV heads, vocab 32002, rope_theta 10000). Notable: config declares sliding_window 4096 on a 32768-token context - the window is the Mistral default carried over, not a served limit, and it is uniform across layers so KV still grows with full context length. This is the archetypal 2023-era community fine-tune: same dense GQA serving shape as the 2025 models, roughly a third of the context. head_dim derived as 4096 / 32 = 128; gqa_ratio = 4.KV bytes/token at bf16 (2 bytes/element): 32 layers x 8 KV heads x 128 head_dim x 2 (K and V) x 2 bytes = 131072 B/token = 128.0 KiB/token. At 32k context that is 4.00 GiB of KV per sequence at bf16. context_scaling is null: context length is native to the pretrained config, no rope_scaling.
